intro: '... and that note you found' begins at the cooling embers of a recently abandoned campsite scattered with supplies. Amid the ashes lies a scorched, blistered parchment bearing a riddle about finding a 'twin land.' With no other guides remaining, the charred scrap offers the only clue toward whatever was left behind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.
Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.
"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
